metadata.title: Resilient Professional Seed: Infrastructure Readiness
metadata.notes: Closing the gap for the stewards of essential community infrastructure.

nodes.title: ABC Water Treatment Operator Level 1
nodes.description: Foundational knowledge for drinking water treatment. Source water protection, treatment processes, and water quality testing. Linked to Greywater Loop track.

nodes.title: NABCEP PV Technical Sales Professional
nodes.description: Analyzing customer needs, site assessment, and economic performance of PV systems. Bridging technical solar knowledge to community procurement.

nodes.title: Community Health Worker (CHW) Standard
nodes.description: Advocacy, outreach, and social support. Navigating healthcare systems and promoting community wellness. Linked to Bioregional Vitality.

nodes.title: SBA Small Business Management
nodes.description: Strategic planning, marketing, and financial management for small enterprises. Mapping the TEND economy to standard SBA business models.

nodes.title: CompTIA IT Operations Specialist (CIOS)
nodes.description: Combined mastery of A+ and Network+. The professional standard for end-to-end IT infrastructure operations.

edges.rationale: Sovereign water catchment provides the practical foundation for municipal water treatment standards.
PV fundamentals are the technical prerequisite for professional solar sales.
First-line emergency care is a core competency requirement for community health workers.
Mutual credit bookkeeping training provides the systemic foundation for SBA financial management.
